description: This file declares functions and constants related to Green Ethernet features and power-saving functionalities for the RTL8367C switch chipset. It provides API declarations for setting and getting green traffic types, managing green port pages, high priority traffic, enabling/disabling green Ethernet, and power saving features.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicGreenTrafficType
methods.description: Sets the traffic type for green Ethernet priorities.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicGreenTrafficType
methods.description: Retrieves the current green Ethernet traffic type for a given priority.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicGreenPortPage
methods.description: Gets the port page associated with green Ethernet configuration.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicGreenHighPriorityTraffic
methods.description: Retrieves indicator information for high priority green Ethernet traffic on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicGreenHighPriorityTraffic
methods.description: Enables high priority green Ethernet traffic on a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicGreenEthernet
methods.description: Enables or disables green Ethernet on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicGreenEthernet
methods.description: Checks whether green Ethernet is enabled for a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPowerSaving
methods.description: Enables or disables power saving mode on a PHY.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPowerSaving
methods.description: Retrieves the power saving status of a PHY.
